scope: Descriptive derived tables;original inferential comparisons remain unchanged in TIMING.json

profile_sampling.scope: Unweighted device-wide samples from first operator start through last operator end on the isolated target GPU;not the full formal anchor,not per-ACK or ACK-weighted activity,not traffic bytes
profile_sampling.export_resolution: Unsigned8-bit integer percentages;zero is a quantized observation,not proof ofzero activity.
profile_sampling.note: Only verified percent fields used;raw signed clock exports and scaled warp-average fields are not guessed or converted.

profile_diagnostics.limitation: Completeness warnings remain disclosed.Independent expected NVTX/API/payload counts are checked per cell;that does not establish complete OSRT/scheduler or internal-driver visibility.
